stem:
A random sample of 5 values of a variable $X$ is given below.

$$2 \qquad 3 \qquad 3 \qquad 5 \qquad a$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find an expression, in terms of $a$, for the mean of these values.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: It is given that an unbiased estimate of the population variance of $X$, using these values, is 4. It is also given that $a$ is positive.
parts.text: Find and simplify a quadratic equation in terms of $a$ and hence find the value of $a$.
